answer: Work-slot burn quota stops sybil farming at the cost layer. Each epoch offers fixed work slots; claiming one burns a 2% deposit of expected reward. Idle identities decay, so bought aged accounts cost more than they earn. Random audits sample claimed slots; fake work forfeits the slot. Cost math is crystal: N fake workers pay N x deposit for zero revenue. The old fable says plant an orchard of fake trees and nobody counts them — here every seedling burns a fee.
